findings.issue: The app ships no tests and no test infrastructure (no runner, no test script, empty devDependencies); every behaviour is guarded only by the external acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or @solidjs/testing-library) with a `npm test` script, and start with unit tests for lib/util.js and lib/data.js query bodies (they are plain async functions over fetch).

findings.issue: Pagination and the three-way filter combination (search + type + generation) are untested; an off-by-one in PAGE_SIZE slicing or the page>totalPages clamp would slip through.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/slice logic into a pure function and unit-test boundary cases: page 1, last page, page beyond range, empty q, combined type+generation with zero matches.

findings.issue: Move-table assembly is untested: method ordering (METHOD_ORDER then alphabetical), level-up default sort with name tie-break, and duplicate rows for multi-level moves are all regression-prone.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the methodEntries sorting with a fixture covering level-up/machine/egg/tutor plus an 'other' method, and a level-up move learned at two levels.

findings.issue: compareValues implements 'missing sorts last in both directions' plus the asc/desc toggle and aria-sort state — the trickiest client logic in the app, untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract compareValues into a testable module and unit-test missing-vs-present in both directions and numeric vs string comparison.

findings.issue: apiFetch caches the promise (including rejected/null results) for the process lifetime, so a transient API failure or 500 permanently serves null for that resource; no test exercises failure semantics.
findings.suggestion: Cache only successful responses (or evict failures), and add a test with a mocked fetch that fails once then succeeds.

findings.issue: If the evolution-chain fetch fails, getPokemonPage returns evolution:null and EvoNode dereferences props.node.name, throwing a server error; the not-found/error path is untested.
findings.suggestion: Guard <EvoNode node={d().evolution}/> with a Show/ternary and add a test for the degraded data path.

findings.issue: URL-state helpers (updateParams omitting empty/default params, resetting page on filter change, pageHref) are untested; a refactor could break the 'omit parameters that are empty or at their default' invariant.
findings.suggestion: Extract URL param building into a pure helper and unit-test it against the spec's URL examples (?type=fire&generation=generation-i).

findings.issue: idFromUrl's regex requires a trailing slash and isAlternateForm's 10000 cutoff are load-bearing everywhere (card collapsing, type filter) and untested.
findings.suggestion: One-line unit tests per helper, including a URL without a trailing slash and ID 10001.

findings.issue: cardsFromPokemonRefs' alternate-form exclusion and multi-form-to-one-species collapsing (deoxys-normal → deoxys) is subtle and untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with refs containing IDs 386 and 10001 mixed, asserting one card for the species and none for the form.

summary: The app contains zero tests of its own — no runner, no test script, no spec files — so the score is the floor on coverage and regression power. All of the app's genuinely risky logic (filtering, pagination, move-table ordering, client-side sorting, URL state, cache failure semantics) sits unguarded in lib/data.js, MoveTables.jsx and routes/index.jsx. The pure helpers in lib/util.js are one-line unit tests the agent left on the table, and a real latent crash (null evolution chain) exists in a path nothing exercises.
